facts.business: DCW Limited is an integrated chemical company with capabilities spanning Basic Chemicals, Specialty Chemicals and chemical intermediates, operating two integrated manufacturing facilities in Dhrangadhra, Gujarat, and Sahupuram, Tamil Nadu.
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act where applicable and details have been disclosed in the Financial Statements as required by applicable Indian Accounting Standards.
